quote: In addition to the above indications, prednisone tablets are indicated for systemic dermatomyositis (polymyositis).
note: Dermatomyositis is named directly as a treated collagen disease on the prednisone label.

quote: SKYSONA is indicated to slow the progression of neurologic dysfunction in boys 4-17 years of age with early, active cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy (CALD)
note: Slowing progression of CALD is management of the disease itself, so CALD is the treatment target.

quote: Botulism (adjunctive therapy to antitoxin), gas gangrene, and tetanus (adjunctive therapy to human tetanus immune globulin) Clostridium species
note: Gas gangrene is a named clinical indication in the penicillin G indication table.

quote: for the symptomatic treatment of: Seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis
note: Seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis are subtypes of allergic rhinitis and are listed as indications.

quote: 1.3 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer LIBTAYO in combination with platinum‐based chemotherapy is indicated for the first‐line treatment of adult patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
note: NSCLC is explicitly indicated on both FDA and EMA text.

quote: indicated as adjunctive therapy for the following seizure types in patients aged 2 years and older: partial-onset seizures. primary generalized tonic-clonic (PGTC) seizures.
note: Primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures are the standard synonym for bilateral tonic-clonic seizures with generalized onset, an indicated seizure type.

quote: Capecitabine tablets are indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adults with pancreatic adenocarcinoma as a component of a combination chemotherapy regimen.
note: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma is named directly as an adjuvant combination-therapy indication.

quote: Acute gouty arthritis Indomethacin is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug indicated for:
note: Acute gouty arthritis is the acute form of gout, a narrower form of the edge disease, and is listed as an indication on most indomethacin labels.

quote: Use Aids in the prevention of dental cavities
note: The only text is a dental-caries prevention claim; muscle weakness is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: Bowel rest is needed because of gastrointestinal surgery or its complications such as ileus, fistulae or anastomotic leaks
note: Ileus appears only as a circumstance requiring parenteral nutrition; the amino acid product is a nutrition source, not a treatment for ileus.

quote: Krx Aesthetics PD-13 Therapy, which includes 13% of Methyl Aminolevulinate HCI, is developed to maximize the client’s satisfaction for PDT(Photo Dynamic Therapy).
note: The only text is a cosmetic PDT product blurb with no indication statement, so the actinic keratosis claim cannot be judged from it.

quote: Oxazepam capsules are indicated for the management of anxiety disorders or for the short-term relief of the symptoms of anxiety.
note: Anxiety disorders and symptoms of anxiety are the named treatment target.

quote: adult and paediatric patients with newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome positive chronic myelogenous leukaemia (CML) in the chronic phase
note: EMA text names Ph+ CML, a subtype of chronic myeloid leukemia, as the treatment target.

quote: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Collagenase Santyl ◊ Ointment is indicated for debriding chronic dermal ulcers
note: The supplied texts cover a debriding ointment and a cosmetic cream; Peyronie disease is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: indicated for the treatment of tinea cruris and tinea corporis caused by Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes, Epidermophyton floccosum, and Microsporum canis
note: Tinea cruris is the standard synonym for dermatophytosis of the groin/perianal area and is an indication.

quote: Complicated skin and skin structure infections, including diabetic foot infections without osteomyelitis.
note: Diabetic foot infection is explicitly named as an indicated infection on FDA and EMA text.

quote: Patients receiving remission-induction chemotherapy for acute myelogenous leukemia (AML) or myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) expected to result in prolonged neutropenia
note: AML is the population receiving antifungal prophylaxis; the thing prevented is invasive fungal infection, not the leukemia.

quote: Doxycycline is indicated in the treatment of trachoma, although the infectious agent is not always eliminated, as judged by immunofluorescence.
note: Trachoma is named directly as a treatment indication.

quote: Vizimpro, as monotherapy, is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
note: EMA text indicates NSCLC (EGFR-mutant subtype) as the treatment target.

quote: for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer
note: Label indicates HR+/HER2- breast cancer; the edge 'breast cancer' is a near parent that still essentially describes what is indicated.

quote: Tevimbra, in combination with etoposide and platinum chemotherapy, is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with extensive-stage SCLC.
note: Extensive-stage SCLC is a subtype of small cell lung carcinoma and is an EMA indication.

quote: The treatment of paediatric patients (age 1 to <18 years) with relapsed or refractory systemic anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL)
note: ALK-positive ALCL, a subtype of anaplastic large cell lymphoma, is an EMA indication.

quote: Nitazoxanide tablets (patients 12 years and older) are indicated for the treatment of diarrhea caused by Giardia lamblia or Cryptosporidium parvum
note: Treating diarrhea caused by Giardia lamblia is treating giardiasis; the infection, not a separate symptom, is the target.

quote: Rivaroxaban tablets are indicated to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
note: Stroke is the event being prevented, so stroke is a prevention target of the drug.

quote: RUKOBIA, in combination with other antiretroviral(s), is indicated for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection
note: The edge disease is an unresolved identifier (UMLS:C2363741) with no name, so it cannot be matched against the HIV-1 infection indication.

quote: Jakavi is indicated for the treatment of adults and paediatric patients aged 6 months and older with chronic graft versus host disease who have inadequate response to corticosteroids
note: Chronic GvHD is named directly as an EMA treatment indication.

quote: In adult patients with clinically evident coronary heart disease, atorvastatin is indicated to: Reduce the risk of non-fatal myocardial infarction Reduce the risk of fatal and non-fatal stroke
note: Single-ingredient atorvastatin labels indicate reduction of stroke risk, so stroke is a prevention target.

quote: Control of severe or incapacitating allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment in asthma, atopic dermatitis, contact dermatitis, drug hypersensitivity reactions,
note: Transfusion reactions are a named item in the list of allergic states hydrocortisone is indicated to control.

quote: Cryptococcus: Meningitis and pulmonary infections have been treated effectively.
note: Only Candida/Cryptococcus pulmonary infections are mentioned; 'recurrent pneumonia' or any reasonable-granularity equivalent is not supported by the text.

quote: because of a history of coronary artery disease, stroke, peripheral vascular disease, or diabetes that is accompanied by at least one other cardiovascular risk factor
note: Diabetes is a risk-factor population for cardiovascular event reduction, not a condition ramipril treats.

quote: Kaposi’s sarcoma
note: Kaposi's sarcoma appears as a listed item in the vinblastine indications text (palliative treatment of responsive malignancies).

quote: As replacement or supplemental therapy in patients with hypothyroidism of any etiology
note: Only hypothyroidism, goiter and thyroid cancer are indicated; bipolar disorder is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: Bowel rest is needed because of gastrointestinal surgery or its complications such as ileus, fistulae or anastomotic leaks
note: Anastomotic leak is only a circumstance that makes parenteral nutrition appropriate; the amino acid product does not treat it.

quote: Maviret is indicated for the treatment of acute and chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection in adults and children aged 3 years and older.
note: Chronic HCV infection is named directly as an EMA indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adult and pediatric patients aged 4 years and older with reversible obstructive airway disease
note: Labels indicate bronchospasm/reversible obstructive airway disease; 'bronchial disorder' is a whole organ-level category far broader than what is indicated.

quote: Enthesitis-related arthritis Hefiya is indicated for the treatment of active enthesitis-related arthritis in patients, 6 years of age and older
note: Enthesitis-related arthritis is listed under the juvenile idiopathic arthritis heading as an EMA indication.

quote: Metoprolol tartrate tablets are indicated in the treatment of hemodynamically stable patients with definite or suspected acute myocardial infarction to reduce cardiovascular mortality
note: Acute myocardial infarction is named directly as a treatment indication.

quote: in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus).
note: Prediabetes appears only as a qualifying comorbidity for the weight-management population, not as a condition treated.
